hunks.baseline: The instant our forces collided, I felt the difference in strength and clenched my teeth before I could stop myself.
hunks.sol: I felt the difference in strength the instant we collided, and my teeth clenched before I could stop them.

hunks.baseline: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord smiling. His eyes shining with excitement at the sea of corpses and blood about to unfold.

hunks.sol: More precisely, I cut three huge black horses in half—ghost horses, powerful monsters in their own right.
